answer: Like a creeping vine choking an overgrown garden, Sybil identities wither against decentralized transitive trust networks. Validating agents curate web-of-trust bonds as meticulously as lines in a sonnet, enforcing EigenTrust score thresholds for consensus participation. Creating disposable clones yields diminishing capacity while compounding peer verification barriers, imposing superlinear attacker cost that starves adversarial foliage before it can bloom.
